newsitem.title: USA: Minntech says CEO Cosentino resigns.
newsitem.headline: Minntech says CEO Cosentino resigns.

text.p: Minntech Corp said Louis C. Cosentino, founder, chairman, chief executive and president, resigned from his operational duties with the corporation but will remain on the board of directors.
Fred Shapiro, a board member, was named acting chairman. Shapiro said, "The board is exploring the role that Dr. Cosentino will play as the company moves forward."
Shapiro said the board will conduct a search for Cosentino's successor. Thomas McGoldrick, executive vice president, was named interim acting president and chief executive, effective immediately.
No reason was given for the resignation of Cosentino, who has been running the company for 23 years.
Minntech is a medical device manufacturer.
